title.zh: 新增华为云码道 CodeArts Agent

description.en: Install it from Agent Marketplace and add a Huawei Cloud access key (AK/SK).
description.zh: 在智能体市场安装，填入华为云访问密钥（AK/SK）即可使用。

title.en: Your workspaces open inside the app
title.zh: 你所在的工作区直接在应用内打开

description.en: From This Computer and Connected Workspaces. Others open in the browser, and the card says why.
description.zh: 在「此电脑」和「已连接的工作区」中点击即可；其他工作区在浏览器中打开，卡片上会说明原因。

description.en: The list opens faster and lines up with its field.
description.zh: 列表打开更快，下拉框与输入框对齐。

description.en: No more "Not Responding" on Windows, and no pause after opening on macOS and Linux.
description.zh: Windows 上不再卡死、无响应，macOS 和 Linux 上打开后不再停顿。

description.en: OpenCode picks a model after you sign in; Kimi, DeepSeek, Pi and CodeBuddy list models with an API key.
description.zh: OpenCode 登录后自动选好模型；Kimi、DeepSeek、Pi、CodeBuddy 填 API 密钥后也能加载列表。

title.en: A crashed window reloads instead of staying blank
title.zh: 窗口崩溃后自动恢复，不再一直空白
